items.question: What breath-control procedure is prescribed for the practice of the brahma-mantra?
premises: A sequence of inhalation, retention, and exhalation has been described.
This sequence is identified as a method of breath-control.
This method is declared for the practice of the brahma-mantra.
items.inference: Therefore, the described breath-control sequence constitutes the prescribed procedure for practicing the brahma-mantra.
uncertainties: The exact referent of brahma-mantra is not specified within this verse.
items.plain_english: This is the declared method of breath-control for the practice of the brahma-mantra.
